run_download_dynamic_replica: run the download_dynamic_replica script to download and extract the Dynamic Replica dataset
run_download_with_checksum: run the download script with checksum verification enabled to validate downloaded archives
run_download_specific_splits: run the download script targeting only train and test splits of the dataset
run_download_with_parallel_workers: run the download script with configurable parallel workers for faster downloading and extraction
run_redownload_existing_archives: run the download script to force re-download of already downloaded archive files
